The 2001 Canadian Grand Prix (round 8, held at Circuit Gilles Villeneuve on 10 June 2001) was won by Ralf Schumacher driving for Williams. His teammate's brother, Michael Schumacher of Ferrari, finished second, and Mika Häkkinen was third.

ANSWER: Ralf Schumacher
